name: ZSP_MODEL_INPUTS
description: This table is used to store the all types of input to the RTD/ILS for sales prediction engine.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_GUID
columns.description: Primary Key for the table.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_CODE
columns.description: Input code, for example, High Value customer or Maximize Revenue etc.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the input code, for example, GROUP,ELIGIBILITY RULE etc.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_DESC
columns.description: Description of the input code.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_XML
columns.description: Character XML attached with any model inputs.

columns.name: MODEL_INPUT_PATH
columns.description: Path of the entity and attribites defined in the ILS.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active Flag Y(yes)/N(no).

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY
columns.description: Resource key from extensibility resource bundle.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: Resource Bundle Id from extensibility resource bundle.

columns.name: EXTENDED_FLAG
columns.description: Extended Flag N/E/Y.

columns.name: OTBI_EXTN_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: OTBI Extensible Physical Table Name.

columns.name: OTBI_EXTN_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: OTBI Extensible Physical Column Name.

columns.name: DWH_EXTN_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: DWH Extensible Physical Table Name.

columns.name: DWH_EXTN_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: DWH Extensible Physical Column Name.

columns.name: OTBI_ODM_VIEW
columns.description: OTBI ODM Database View Name.

columns.name: DWH_ODM_VIEW
columns.description: DWH ODM Database View Name.

columns.name: ODM_TRAIN_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: ODM Training Attributes Name.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
